name: print-social-instagram-profile-in-hand-among-tropical-leaves
title: Language-school Instagram profile on a phone held before tropical foliage
whatItIs: A rounded brown-outlined image of a hand holding a phone in front of blurred leaves and pink flowers. The screen shows a school profile with a multicolour post grid in blue, orange, pink, green and red.
whatItMeans: Fresh and friendly; natural greens make the colourful grid feel lively.
techniques: Use out-of-focus plants as a natural backdrop.
Let the grid's varied colours pop against greens.
Hold the phone slightly tilted for a candid feel.
Frame it in a cream border.

vocabulary.definition: A feed with several bright hues held together by layout.
A device shot that looks casually taken.
A pale border around a photo.
